storage: D: NTFS, filesystem caches not flushed
sampling: Engines run serially, without concurrent local compilation, race tests, site builds or profiling. Unrelated workstation activity, power and thermals are not controlled.
repetitions: 5 planned samples per primary point; slow/incomplete cases retain limits and planned not_repeated rows. Instrumented growth and audited recovery are separate matrices.
case_limits: 60s context includes setup/warmup; 65s parent hard deadline. Neither value is a per-operation SLO or a lower bound on uncompleted operation time.
allocation_scope: Cumulative Go allocation deltas per measured operation, not peak heap/RSS.
disk_scope: Durable growth meters successful-Save logical JSON bytes (1GiB budget per isolated run), not physical writes; SQLite reports current file sizes/history, not equivalent cumulative writes.
